experiment: L1XFER: N=15 L=1 parameter concentration and transfer, frozen v4 center-4 Nov3 vs QAOA p=1
literature_context: typical-instance / parameter-concentration structure in SK-QAOA literature (arXiv:2204.02923 context). Not paper V(M). Not an architecture change.
closed_l3_levers: PR99/101/102/115 start-count / freeze-order / shell-unshare / two-stage / layer-tied-SNAP exhausted; this stream is L=1 transfer only

hypothesis.one_sentence: At N=15 L=1, a coordinate-wise mean of 8 trained Nov3 parameter vectors transfers to 8 unread test instances with shared-mean Nov3−QAOA mean ΔE CI entirely <0.
hypothesis.not: Not L2/L3. Not a GR patch. Not an adoption. Not an architecture change. Not choosing mean vs median on test.

split_documented_before_fits.rule: Stage A fits train only. Freeze mean and median from train vectors before any test SPSA or transfer energy. Both aggregators frozen; primary label uses mean; median is not selected on test.

freeze_from_train.layout: LE x (Nov3 identical to FT; QAOA p=1 stacked=interleaved)

transfer_eval.charge: every energy call; no query-free prefix

selection: FT energy selection on independent fits. F post hoc, never selects. Transfer evals use the frozen vector as-is (no SPSA on test for those cells).

contrasts.1_train: independently optimized Nov3 − QAOA on train 10600-07
contrasts.2_test_transfer_fair: shared-mean Nov3 − shared-mean QAOA on test, and separately shared-median − shared-median
contrasts.3_test_ceiling: independently optimized Nov3 − QAOA on test 10608-15
contrasts.4_transfer_gap: test shared-mean Nov3 vs independently optimized Nov3 on test (descriptive; not a gate that Nov3 must beat itself)

report.primary_label: TRANSFER_MEAN_NEGATIVE_CI iff test shared-mean Nov3−QAOA bootstrap 95% CI (4000, rng 3334) of mean ΔE is entirely <0 on n=8; else UNSTABLE
report.concentration: Report train mean/std/range of packed coordinates with the n=8 caveat
report.gr: Do not patch GR. No final. No L2+. No L3. No adoption.
